# cancho

> Tools built for agents, not adapted from humans: a native systems language, and the ecosystem built with it, where trust comes from verification, not comprehension.

Status: pre-1.0. Alpha products are built with it; the compiler is the Rust one, and a second compiler written in cancho is being checked against it (it does not yet refuse everything the language refuses). See the roadmap for what is open.

Manifesto (the idea behind it): https://alpibru.com/manifesto
Source: https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho
Docs: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho/
Roadmap: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho/ROADMAP.html
Writing cancho programs (agents): https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho/blob/main/AGENTS.md
This site as Markdown: https://cancho.dev/agents.md
Everything in one file: https://cancho.dev/llms-full.txt
The ecosystem as JSON: https://cancho.dev/data/ecosystem.json

## Ecosystem

- [cancho-ui](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-ui) (built): A UI language whose compiler knows what each component is allowed to do. Builds JavaScript and DOM. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-ui/
- [cancho-hooks](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-hooks) (alpha): Webhook delivery: on disk before the 202, signed, retried, dead-lettered and replayable. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-hooks/
- [cancho-cache](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-cache) (alpha): Redis-compatible cache over RESP2 and RESP3: strings and hashes, expiry and LRU eviction, in a fixed arena. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-cache/
- [cancho-gateway](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-gateway) (early): An HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy you can audit: strict, bounded request parsing, no FFI, a checkable authority report. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-gateway/
- [cancho-mqtt](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-mqtt) (alpha): An MQTT broker you can reason about: 3.1.1 over plain TCP, QoS 0 to 2, retained messages, wills and persistent sessions, on one thread with bounded memory. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-mqtt/
- [cancho-dns](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-dns) (early): A forwarding and caching DNS resolver: a bounded packet parser, an answer cache in a fixed arena, no FFI. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-dns/
- [cancho-oci](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-oci) (alpha): Container images without a daemon: oci-build assembles a reproducible FROM-scratch image from static executables.
- [cancho-pg](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-pg) (early): PostgreSQL client: v3 protocol, SCRAM-SHA-256, extended queries, TLS, non-blocking pool.
- [cancho-schema](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-schema) (early): Schemas as data: validation, problem+json errors and JSON Schema 2020-12 from one value.
- [cancho-web](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-web) (alpha): Typed routes, validated bodies, problem+json errors and an OpenAPI document from one declaration. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-web/
- [cancho-log](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-log) (early): A durable, segmented, append-only log with crash-safe recovery that cuts off a torn tail.
- [cancho-stats](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-stats) (built): Statistics whose last digit you can check: a command line for describing data and drawing inferences, with exact sums and error bounds written before the code. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-stats/
- [cancho-ml](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-ml) (alpha): Classical machine learning on tabular data as a command line an agent can read: seven models, one JSON line out, or a named refusal with a repair. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-ml/
- [cancho-tools](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-tools) (early): Ten small tools for agents (seek, list, peek, jsonq, tally, hash, write, replace, move, archive) and one opt-in, run. JSON out, tagged refusals that often carry a repair. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-tools/
- [cancho-table](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-table) (early): Select, filter, group and aggregate CSV/TSV for agents; bounded, exact, byte-stable. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-table/
- [cancho-robot](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-robot) (design): A robot arm controller: the Feetech servo bus, SO-101 kinematics and a safety core every motion goes through. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-robot/
- [cancho-gpu](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-gpu) (built): A compiler for typed tile kernels (.chx) to CUDA C and Metal, written in cancho; it also runs language models on a Metal GPU. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-gpu/
- [cancho-code](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-code) (built): An AI coding assistant that proves its work: the cancho compiler checks every piece the model writes, and a task is done only when the compiler and the task's own examples say so. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-code/
- [cancho-forge](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-forge) (built): An agent-run software company you can audit: state, budgets, approvals and evidence are kept by the runtime, and a worker cannot accept its own work. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-forge/
- [cancho-hdl](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-hdl) (built): One .chw file declares the software/hardware boundary (registers, fields, interrupts, DMA); it is checked, and a C header, device tree, SystemVerilog RTL and CMSIS-SVD are generated from it. Page: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-hdl/
- [cancho-client-gen](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-client-gen) (built): Reads the OpenAPI 3.1 document that cancho-web generates and writes strictly typed clients; the contract, both ways.
- [cancho-fetch](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-fetch) (design): An agent-safe fetch: HTTP and HTTPS to a fixed, built-in list of hosts, with the list in the binary's authority row instead of a flag.
- [cancho-mqtt-client](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-mqtt-client) (design): An MQTT 3.1.1 client library: connect, publish, subscribe, will, QoS 0 and 1, and a reconnect with bounded backoff. The other half of cancho-mqtt.
